evals.name: general-web-onepager
evals.prompt: Can you put together a one-page HTML site for my consulting practice? Just the basics — a short intro about what I do, three service areas with a sentence each, and a contact line at the bottom. Save it as consulting.html.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained branded HTML page using the Love Brand, no book content.

evals.name: data-report-dark
evals.prompt: I need an html report summarizing our Q2 numbers for the team — revenue was 1.42M (up from 1.19M), churn 4.2%, 38 new accounts, NPS 51. Include a table and pull out the key figures so they're scannable. I'll be reading it at night so make it dark. Call it q2-report.html
evals.expected_output: Dark-mode branded report with stats and a table; gold used as text is acceptable in dark.

evals.name: book-chapter-excerpt
evals.prompt: Make an html page with an excerpt from chapter 7 of my book about mercy — a couple paragraphs, the canonical definition of God's Perfect Love, and Psalm 85:10. Something I could send to a friend to read.
evals.expected_output: Branded page, light mode, definition verbatim with no Oxford comma, RSV citation.
